The interface check is separate from the conformance run so\n# that a missing or non-executable program and a genuine conformance failure are distinguishable\n# in the evidence. The program path is the harness's only knowledge of the implementation\n# language; the harness itself is language-neutral.\n#\n# The suite runs unfiltered: no --pattern, no --number, no selector of any kind. spec_tests.py\n# exits with failed + errored, so exit 0 means the complete CommonMark 0.31.2 suite passed.\nset -eu\n\nif [ ! -x ./commonmark ]; then\n    echo \"error: no executable ./commonmark at the application root.\" >&2\n    echo \"The deliverable is an executable named commonmark that reads UTF-8 Markdown on stdin\" >&2\n    echo \"and writes HTML to stdout.\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n\n# spec_tests.py imports cmark and normalize as siblings, so the staged directory has to be on the\n# import path. The program is passed absolute because the runner spawns it from its own cwd.\nPYTHONPATH=\"$PWD/sources${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}\"\nexport PYTHONPATH\n\nset +e\noutput=$(python3 sources/spec_tests.py --program \"$PWD/commonmark\" --spec sources/spec.txt 2>&1)\nstatus=$?\nset -e\n\nprintf '%s\\n' \"$output\"\n\n# The runner exits with failed + errored, which a shell truncates modulo 256: exactly 256 or 512\n# failures would exit 0 and read as a pass. Invalid UTF-8 bytes become U+FFFD. LF, CR, and CRLF are all line endings. U+0000 is replaced with U+FFFD.\n- **Output (stdout):** rendered HTML only, encoded as UTF-8.\n- **Diagnostics (stderr):** used only for internal errors.\n- **Arguments:** none. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_017XBAA2swif3AAwV5BRDtR1","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Phase 2: inline parsing.\n\nResponsibility: parse the raw text of paragraphs and headings into inline nodes with the\ndelimiter-stack algorithms (look for link or image, process emphasis), using the reference map\nfrom `mdparser.refs`.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport re\nimport string\n\nfrom mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url\n\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n# The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,\n# `<` and `>`. The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n# A backtick string is a maximal run of backticks. Code spans open and close on runs of equal length.\nBACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"`+\")\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.\n_WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\"\n# Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly.\n_WS_REQUIRED = r\"(?=[ \\t\\n])\" + _WS\n_TAG_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\"\n_ATTR_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:\\-]*\"\n# An unquoted value is nonempty and has no whitespace, quote, `=`, `<`, `>` or backtick.\n_UNQUOTED_VALUE = r\"[^ \\t\\n\\r\\\"'=<>`]+\"\n_ATTR_VALUE = rf\"(?:{_UNQUOTED_VALUE}|'[^']*'|\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\")\"\n_ATTRIBUTE = rf\"{_WS_REQUIRED}{_ATTR_NAME}(?:{_WS}={_WS}{_ATTR_VALUE})?\"\n# The raw HTML grammars from the spec, tried in order. Each one is anchored at the `<` by `match`.\nRAW_HTML_PATTERNS = tuple(\n    re.compile(pattern)\n    for pattern in (\n        rf\"<{_TAG_NAME}(?:{_ATTRIBUTE})*{_WS}/?>\",\n        rf\"</{_TAG_NAME}{_WS}>\",\n        # `<!-->` and `<!--->` are complete comments; any other comment ends at the first `-->`.\n        r\"<!--(?:>|->|(?s:.*?)-->)\",\n        r\"<\\?(?s:.*?)\\?>\",\n        r\"<![A-Za-z][^>]*>\",\n        r\"<!\\[CDATA\\[(?s:.*?)\\]\\]>\",\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. At each special character the constructs that start there are\n    tried, and the first one that matches is taken whole. Code spans, autolinks and raw HTML have\n    equal precedence, so whichever starts first wins. A backtick string with no closing run of the\n    same length is literal text, and the whole run is consumed. An autolink or raw HTML tag is taken\n    whole, so a backslash inside it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that\n    character, so `\\\\<` and `\\\\`` do not open a construct. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"`\":\n            code_span = _match_code_span(raw, index)\n            if code_span is not None:\n                html, index = code_span\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            run_end = BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.match(raw, index).end()\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index:run_end]))\n            index = run_end\n            continue\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_code_span(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the code span HTML for a backtick string at `start` and the index just past it.\n\n    The span closes at the next backtick string of exactly the same length. Returns None when no\n    such closing run exists, so the opening run is literal text.\n    \"\"\"\n    opener = BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    width = len(opener.group())\n    content_start = opener.end()\n    for closer in BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.finditer(raw, content_start):\n        if len(closer.group()) == width:\n            content = _normalize_code_content(raw[content_start : closer.start()])\n            return f\"<code>{escape_html(content)}</code>\", closer.end()\n    return None\n\n\ndef _normalize_code_content(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Turn line endings into spaces, then strip one space from each end when both ends are spaces.\n\n    Stripping is skipped when the content is entirely spaces. Only U+0020 counts as a space.\n    \"\"\"\n    text = text.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n    if len(text) >= 2 and text[0] == \" \" and text[-1] == \" \" and text.strip(\" \"):\n        return text[1:-1]\n    return text\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _match_raw_html(raw: str, start: int) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the index just past the raw HTML construct at `start`, or None if none matches.\"\"\"\n    for pattern in RAW_HTML_PATTERNS:\n        match = pattern.match(raw, start)\n        if match is not None:\n            return match.end()\n    return None\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n----\n\"\"\"Character references and backslash escapes.\n\nResponsibility: decode named entities (from the standard library table `html.entities.html5`,\nnames ending in a semicolon only) and numeric character references, and provide the backslash\nunescape helper.\n\"\"\"\n\"\"\"Link reference definitions: extraction, the document-wide reference map, and `normalize_label`.\n\nResponsibility: extract link reference definitions when a paragraph closes, store them in one\nreference map, and normalize labels with `str.casefold` plus whitespace collapse.\n\"\"\"\n\"\"\"HTML rendering.\n\nResponsibility: turn the parsed tree into HTML, escape HTML text and attributes, and\npercent-encode URLs. The conformance runner compares normalized HTML, so tag structure and\nentities must match the spec examples.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport string\nfrom collections.abc import Callable\n\nfrom mdparser.blocks import Block\n\nInlineParser = Callable[[str], str]\n\nESCAPES = ((\"&\", \"&amp;\"), (\"<\", \"&lt;\"), (\">\", \"&gt;\"), ('\"', \"&quot;\"))\nURL_SAFE_CHARS = frozenset(string.ascii_letters + string.digits + \";,/?:@&=+$-_.!~*'()#\")\nHEX_DIGITS = frozenset(string.hexdigits)\n\n\ndef escape_html(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Escape &, <, > and \" so the text renders as literal characters. The ampersand goes first.\"\"\"\n    for raw, entity in ESCAPES:\n        text = text.replace(raw, entity)\n    return text\n\n\ndef percent_encode_url(url: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Percent-encode a URL for use in an attribute.\n\n    URL-safe ASCII and existing %XX escapes are kept. Every other character is encoded as its\n    UTF-8 bytes, so a lone % becomes %25.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(url):\n        char = url[index]\n        if char == \"%\" and _is_hex_pair(url[index + 1 : index + 3]):\n            out.append(url[index : index + 3])\n            index += 3\n            continue\n        if char in URL_SAFE_CHARS:\n            out.append(char)\n        else:\n            out.extend(f\"%{byte:02X}\" for byte in char.encode(\"utf-8\"))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _is_hex_pair(text: str) -> bool:\n    return len(text) == 2 and all(char in HEX_DIGITS for char in text)\n\n\ndef render_document(root: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Phase 2 walk: render the top-level blocks in order, one line ending after each block.\n\n    `parse_inline` is the inline parser hook. It receives the raw content of each paragraph and\n    returns that content's HTML.\n    \"\"\"\n    return \"\".join(_render_block(child, parse_inline) for child in root.children)\n\n\ndef _render_block(block: Block, parse_inline: InlineParser) -> str:\n    if block.kind.name == \"paragraph\":\n        return f\"<p>{parse_inline(block.content)}</p>\\n\"\n    raise ValueError(f\"no HTML renderer for block type {block.kind.name!r}\")\n\"\"\"mdparser: a CommonMark 0.31.2 parser delivered as the stdin-to-stdout `commonmark` executable.\n\nThe package uses only the Python standard library. Its phase-1 block structure and phase-2\ninline structure live in the modules below.\n\"\"\"\n----\n\"\"\"Shared pytest fixtures for the mdparser test suite.\"\"\"\n\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nPROJECT_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef project_root() -> Path:\n    \"\"\"Absolute path to the application root, where `commonmark` and `pyproject.toml` live.\"\"\"\n    return PROJECT_ROOT\n----\n#!/bin/bash\n# CommandCenter Operation\n# Name: Run Test Suite\n# Type: batch\n\n# --- Standard Preamble ---\nset -euo pipefail\nSCRIPT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$(dirname \"${BASH_SOURCE[0]}\")\" && pwd)\"\nPROJECT_DIR=\"$(cd \"$SCRIPT_DIR/..\" && pwd)\"\nLOG_DIR=\"$PROJECT_DIR/data/logs\"\nmkdir -p \"$LOG_DIR\"\n\nTIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H%M%S')\nSCRIPT_NAME=$(basename \"$0\" .sh)\nLOG_FILE=\"$LOG_DIR/${SCRIPT_NAME}_${TIMESTAMP}.log\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME started at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Arguments: $*\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"Working dir: $PROJECT_DIR\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\necho \"---\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\ncd \"$PROJECT_DIR\"\n\n# --- Test Command (pyproject.toml foundation contract: pytest -q, run inside .venv) ---\nif [ ! -x .venv/bin/python ]; then\n    echo \"error: .venv missing; run 'uv venv .venv && uv sync' first\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\" >&2\n    exit 1\nfi\n.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q \"$@\" 2>&1 | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n\necho \"=== $SCRIPT_NAME finished at $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') ===\" | tee -a \"$LOG_FILE\"\n----\n\"\"\"Code span tests: backtick matching by length, content normalization, literal unmatched runs,\ninert backslashes and entities, and precedence against autolinks and raw HTML.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. No test matches a substring of output.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Code-Spans.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_codespans_corpus_sections_pass_in_full(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC codespans-corpus-sections: the scoped Code spans and Inlines sections exit 0.\"\"\"\n    result = subprocess.run(\n        [\n            sys.executable,\n            \"sources/spec_tests.py\",\n            \"--program\",\n            str(project_root / \"commonmark\"),\n            \"--spec\",\n            \"sources/spec.txt\",\n            \"--pattern\",\n            \"^Code spans$|^Inlines$\",\n        ],\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n\n\ndef \"`some code`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p><code>some code</code></p>\\n\"\n\n\ndef test_codespans_backtick_length_match(project_root: that a backslash may escape.\nASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)\n\n\ndef unescape(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Apply backslash escapes to `text`, for destinations, titles and info The URI and email rules are checked against this body.\nAUTOLINK_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"<([^\\x00-\\x20\\x7f<>]*)>\")\n# A scheme is 2 to 32 characters: an ASCII letter, then letters, digits, `+`, `.` or `-`.\nURI_SCHEME_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9+.\\-]{1,31}:\")\n# The non-normative HTML5 email address regex from the spec, without its anchors.\nEMAIL_PATTERN = re.compile(\n    r\"[a-zA-Z0-9.!#$%&'*+/=?^_`{|}~-]+\"\n    r\"@[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?\"\n    r\"(?:\\.[a-zA-Z0-9](?:[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,61}[a-zA-Z0-9])?)*\"\n)\n\n# A backtick string is a maximal run of backticks. Code spans open and close on runs of equal length.\nBACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"`+\")\n\n# Whitespace in a raw HTML tag: spaces and tabs, with at most one line ending.\n_WS = r\"[ \\t]*(?:\\n[ \\t]*)?\"\n# Whitespace that must be present: an attribute cannot follow its tag name or value directly.\n_WS_REQUIRED = r\"(?=[ \\t\\n])\" + _WS\n_TAG_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9\\-]*\"\n_ATTR_NAME = r\"[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_.:\\-]*\"\n# An unquoted value is nonempty and has no whitespace, quote, `=`, `<`, `>` or backtick.\n_UNQUOTED_VALUE = r\"[^ \\t\\n\\r\\\"'=<>`]+\"\n_ATTR_VALUE = rf\"(?:{_UNQUOTED_VALUE}|'[^']*'|\\\"[^\\\"]*\\\")\"\n_ATTRIBUTE = rf\"{_WS_REQUIRED}{_ATTR_NAME}(?:{_WS}={_WS}{_ATTR_VALUE})?\"\n# The raw HTML grammars from the spec, tried in order. Each one is anchored at the `<` by `match`.\nRAW_HTML_PATTERNS = tuple(\n    re.compile(pattern)\n    for pattern in (\n        rf\"<{_TAG_NAME}(?:{_ATTRIBUTE})*{_WS}/?>\",\n        rf\"</{_TAG_NAME}{_WS}>\",\n        # `<!-->` and `<!--->` are complete comments; any other comment ends at the first `-->`.\n        r\"<!--(?:>|->|(?s:.*?)-->)\",\n        r\"<\\?(?s:.*?)\\?>\",\n        r\"<![A-Za-z][^>]*>\",\n        r\"<!\\[CDATA\\[(?s:.*?)\\]\\]>\",\n    )\n)\n\n\ndef parse_inline(raw: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Inline parser hook: return the HTML for a block's raw content.\n\n    The scan runs left to right. At each special character the constructs that start there are\n    tried, and the first one that matches is taken whole. Code spans, autolinks and raw HTML have\n    equal precedence, so whichever starts first wins. A backtick string with no closing run of the\n    same length is literal text, and the whole run is consumed. An autolink or raw HTML tag is taken\n    whole, so a backslash inside it stays literal. A backslash before ASCII punctuation yields that\n    character, so `\\\\<` and `\\\\`` do not open a construct. Everything else is escaped text.\n    \"\"\"\n    out: list[str] = []\n    index = 0\n    while index < len(raw):\n        char = raw[index]\n        if char == \"`\":\n            code_span = _match_code_span(raw, index)\n            if code_span is not None:\n                html, index = code_span\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            run_end = BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.match(raw, index).end()\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index:run_end]))\n            index = run_end\n            continue\n        if char == \"<\":\n            autolink = _match_autolink(raw, index)\n            if autolink is not None:\n                html, index = autolink\n                out.append(html)\n                continue\n            raw_html_end = _match_raw_html(raw, index)\n            if raw_html_end is not None:\n                out.append(raw[index:raw_html_end])\n                index = raw_html_end\n                continue\n        elif char == \"\\\\\" and index + 1 < len(raw) and raw[index + 1] in ASCII_PUNCTUATION:\n            out.append(escape_html(raw[index + 1]))\n            index += 2\n            continue\n        out.append(escape_html(char))\n        index += 1\n    return \"\".join(out)\n\n\ndef _match_code_span(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the code span HTML for a backtick string at `start` and the index just past it.\n\n    The span closes at the next backtick string of exactly the same length. Returns None when no\n    such closing run exists, so the opening run is literal text.\n    \"\"\"\n    opener = BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    width = len(opener.group())\n    content_start = opener.end()\n    for closer in BACKTICK_RUN_PATTERN.finditer(raw, content_start):\n        if len(closer.group()) == width:\n            content = _normalize_code_content(raw[content_start : closer.start()])\n            return f\"<code>{escape_html(content)}</code>\", closer.end()\n    return None\n\n\ndef _normalize_code_content(text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Turn line endings into spaces, then strip one space from each end when both ends are spaces.\n\n    Stripping is skipped when the content is entirely spaces. Only U+0020 counts as a space.\n    \"\"\"\n    text = text.replace(\"\\n\", \" \")\n    if len(text) >= 2 and text[0] == \" \" and text[-1] == \" \" and text.strip(\" \"):\n        return text[1:-1]\n    return text\n\n\ndef _match_autolink(raw: str, start: int) -> tuple[str, int] | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the link HTML for an autolink at `start` and the index just past it, or None.\"\"\"\n    match = AUTOLINK_PATTERN.match(raw, start)\n    if match is None:\n        return None\n    body = match.group(1)\n    if URI_SCHEME_PATTERN.match(body):\n        href = body\n    elif EMAIL_PATTERN.fullmatch(body):\n        href = \"mailto:\" + body\n    else:\n        return None\n    return _link_html(href, body), match.end()\n\n\ndef _match_raw_html(raw: str, start: int) -> int | None:\n    \"\"\"Return the index just past the raw HTML construct at `start`, or None if none matches.\"\"\"\n    for pattern in RAW_HTML_PATTERNS:\n        match = pattern.match(raw, start)\n        if match is not None:\n            return match.end()\n    return None\n\n\ndef _link_html(href: str, text: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Render a link: the href is percent-encoded then escaped; the label is escaped text.\"\"\"\n    return f'<a href=\"{escape_html(percent_encode_url(href))}\">{escape_html(text)}</a>'\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":6,"oldLines":12,"newStart":6,"newLines":10,"lines":[" \"\"\""," "," import re","-import string"," ","+from mdparser.entities import ASCII_PUNCTUATION"," from mdparser.render import escape_html, percent_encode_url"," ","-ASCII_PUNCTUATION = frozenset(string.punctuation)","-"," # The body of an autolink: everything between `<` and `>` except ASCII control characters, space,"," # `<` and `>`. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg1dqwezEb35xorjYNL8p","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01JQF6sQARwSgkAb6AzKKyDx","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/mnt/c/Users/barlo/projects/drydock/uat/CommonMark/runs/20261014.053711/build/commonmark/tests/test_backslash_escapes.py","content":"\"\"\"Backslash escape tests: escaped ASCII punctuation in text, literal backslashes before other\ncharacters, inertness inside code spans, and the shared `unescape` helper used for link\ndestinations, titles and info strings.\n\nEach test compares a returned string or the executable's stdout bytes with its exact expected\nvalue. The declared acceptance checks are transcribed from FEATURE-Backslash-Escapes.md.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport string\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\nfrom mdparser.entities import ASCII_PUNCTUATION, unescape\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Backslash-Escapes.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_escapes_punctuation_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-punctuation-inert: an escaped asterisk prevents emphasis.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\*not emphasized*\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<em>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"\\\\\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_escapes_non_punctuation_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-non-punctuation-literal: a backslash before a non-punctuation character is kept.\"\"\"\n    text = \"\\\\A\\\\a\\\\3\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, text + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert text in result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_escapes_block_markers(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-block-markers: an escaped heading marker does not start a heading.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\# word\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_escapes_inert_in_code_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-inert-in-code-span: a backslash in a code span is not an escape.\"\"\"\n    content = \"\\\\*\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\" + content + \"`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert content in result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\n# --- Escaped punctuation in text ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"char\", sorted(string.punctuation))\ndef test_escaped_punctuation_yields_the_character(char: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Every ASCII punctuation character escaped by a backslash is plain text, without the backslash.\"\"\"\n    expected = \"<p>\" + (\"&quot;\" if char == '\"' else char.replace(\"&\", \"&amp;\")\n                         .replace(\"<\", \"&lt;\").replace(\">\", \"&gt;\")) + \"</p>\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\" + char) == expected\n\n\ndef test_ascii_punctuation_set_matches_the_spec_list() -> None:\n    \"\"\"The escapable set is exactly the 32 ASCII punctuation characters.\"\"\"\n    assert len(ASCII_PUNCTUATION) == 32\n    assert \"\\\\\" in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n    assert \" \" not in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n    assert \"A\" not in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"char\", [\"*\", \"_\", \"`\", \"[\", \"]\", \"<\", \"&\", \"#\", \"!\", \"|\"])\ndef test_escaped_character_that_opens_a_construct_is_inert(char: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash makes a construct-opening character literal, so no construct starts there.\"\"\"\n    assert \"\\\\\" not in inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\" + char + \"x\" + char)\n\n\ndef test_escaped_backslash_leaves_next_character_unescaped() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`\\\\\\\\` yields one backslash, and the following backtick is still a live opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\\\\`a`\") == \"\\\\<code>a</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_backtick_does_not_open_a_code_span() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes it literal, so it cannot open a span.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\`a`\") == \"`a`\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_ampersand_is_escaped_as_text() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escaped ampersand is shown as a literal ampersand, so an entity-like form is not decoded.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\&amp;\") == \"&amp;amp;\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_quote_renders_as_quot_entity() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escaped double quote renders as the `&quot;` entity, with no backslash.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('\\\\\"') == \"<p>&quot;</p>\"[3:-4]\n\n\ndef test_trailing_lone_backslash_is_literal() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash at the very end of the text is kept, since nothing follows it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"a\\\\\") == \"a\\\\\"\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_non_punctuation_is_kept() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a letter, digit or space stays in the text.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\a\\\\3\\\\ b\") == \"\\\\a\\\\3\\\\ b\"\n\n\ndef test_escape_inside_a_longer_text_run() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escape in the middle of plain text consumes only its own two characters.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"x\\\\*y*z\") == \"x*y*z\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_text_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The executable writes exactly the escaped paragraph and nothing else.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\*a\\\\* b\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>*a* b</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- The shared unescape helper ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"text\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n        (\"plain\", \"plain\"),\n        (\"\\\\*\", \"*\"),\n        (\"\\\\\\\\\", \"\\\\\"),\n        (\"\\\\a\", \"\\\\a\"),\n        (\"a\\\\\", \"a\\\\\"),\n        (\"\\\\\\\\*\", \"\\\\*\"),\n        (\"\\\\*\\\\_\", \"*_\"),\n        (\"a\\\\(b\\\\)\", \"a(b)\"),\n        (\"\\\\ \\\\\\n\", \"\\\\ \\\\\\n\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_unescape_applies_the_backslash_rule(text: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The helper yields escaped punctuation and keeps every other backslash.\"\"\"\n    assert unescape(text) == expected\n\n\ndef test_unescape_leaves_entities_undecoded() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Entity decoding is separate, so `&amp;` passes through the helper as written.\"\"\"\n    assert unescape(\"\\\\&amp;\") == \"&amp;\"\n\n\ndef test_unescape_is_idempotent_after_one_pass() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A second pass over an unescaped result changes nothing when no backslash is left.\"\"\"\n    once = unescape(\"\\\\*a\\\\_b\")\n    assert once == \"*a_b\"\n    assert unescape(once) == once\n\n\ndef test_unescape_empty_string_is_empty() -> None:\n    \"\"\"The empty string has no escapes and stays empty.\"\"\"\n    assert unescape(\"\") == The declared acceptance checks are transcribed from FEATURE-Backslash-Escapes.md.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport string\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\nfrom mdparser.entities import ASCII_PUNCTUATION, unescape\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Backslash-Escapes.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_escapes_punctuation_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-punctuation-inert: an escaped asterisk prevents emphasis.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\*not emphasized*\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<em>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"\\\\\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_escapes_non_punctuation_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-non-punctuation-literal: a backslash before a non-punctuation character is kept.\"\"\"\n    text = \"\\\\A\\\\a\\\\3\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, text + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert text in result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_escapes_block_markers(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-block-markers: an escaped heading marker does not start a heading.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\# word\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_escapes_inert_in_code_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-inert-in-code-span: a backslash in a code span is not an escape.\"\"\"\n    content = \"\\\\*\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\" + content + \"`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert content in result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\n# --- Escaped punctuation in text ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"char\", sorted(string.punctuation))\ndef test_escaped_punctuation_yields_the_character(char: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Every ASCII punctuation character escaped by a backslash is plain text, without the backslash.\"\"\"\n    expected = \"<p>\" + (\"&quot;\" if char == '\"' else char.replace(\"&\", \"&amp;\")\n                         .replace(\"<\", \"&lt;\").replace(\">\", \"&gt;\")) + \"</p>\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\" + char) == expected\n\n\ndef test_ascii_punctuation_set_matches_the_spec_list() -> None:\n    \"\"\"The escapable set is exactly the 32 ASCII punctuation characters.\"\"\"\n    assert len(ASCII_PUNCTUATION) == 32\n    assert \"\\\\\" in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n    assert \" \" not in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n    assert \"A\" not in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"char\", [\"*\", \"_\", \"`\", \"[\", \"]\", \"<\", \"&\", \"#\", \"!\", \"|\"])\ndef test_escaped_character_that_opens_a_construct_is_inert(char: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash makes a construct-opening character literal, so no construct starts there.\"\"\"\n    assert \"\\\\\" not in inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\" + char + \"x\" + char)\n\n\ndef test_escaped_backslash_leaves_next_character_unescaped() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`\\\\\\\\` yields one backslash, and the following backtick is still a live opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\\\\`a`\") == \"\\\\<code>a</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_backtick_does_not_open_a_code_span() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes it literal, so it cannot open a span.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\`a`\") == \"`a`\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_ampersand_is_escaped_as_text() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escaped ampersand is shown as a literal ampersand, so an entity-like form is not decoded.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\&amp;\") == \"&amp;amp;\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_quote_renders_as_quot_entity() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escaped double quote renders as the `&quot;` entity, with no backslash.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('\\\\\"') == \"<p>&quot;</p>\"[3:-4]\n\n\ndef test_trailing_lone_backslash_is_literal() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash at the very end of the text is kept, since nothing follows it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"a\\\\\") == \"a\\\\\"\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_non_punctuation_is_kept() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a letter, digit or space stays in the text.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\a\\\\3\\\\ b\") == \"\\\\a\\\\3\\\\ b\"\n\n\ndef test_escape_inside_a_longer_text_run() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escape in the middle of plain text consumes only its own two characters.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"x\\\\*y*z\") == \"x*y*z\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_text_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The executable writes exactly the escaped paragraph and nothing else.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\*a\\\\* b\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>*a* b</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- The shared unescape helper ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"text\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n        (\"plain\", \"plain\"),\n        (\"\\\\*\", \"*\"),\n        (\"\\\\\\\\\", \"\\\\\"),\n        (\"\\\\a\", \"\\\\a\"),\n        (\"a\\\\\", \"a\\\\\"),\n        (\"\\\\\\\\*\", \"\\\\*\"),\n        (\"\\\\*\\\\_\", \"*_\"),\n        (\"a\\\\(b\\\\)\", \"a(b)\"),\n        (\"\\\\ \\\\\\n\", \"\\\\ \\\\\\n\"),\n    ],\n)\ndef test_unescape_applies_the_backslash_rule(text: str, expected: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The helper yields escaped punctuation and keeps every other backslash.\"\"\"\n    assert unescape(text) == expected\n\n\ndef test_unescape_leaves_entities_undecoded() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Entity decoding is separate, so `&amp;` passes through the helper as written.\"\"\"\n    assert unescape(\"\\\\&amp;\") == \"&amp;\"\n\n\ndef test_unescape_is_idempotent_after_one_pass() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A second pass over an unescaped result changes nothing when no backslash is left.\"\"\"\n    once = unescape(\"\\\\*a\\\\_b\")\n    assert once == \"*a_b\"\n    assert unescape(once) The declared acceptance checks are transcribed from FEATURE-Backslash-Escapes.md.\n\"\"\"\n\nimport string\nimport subprocess\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom mdparser import inlines\nfrom mdparser.entities import ASCII_PUNCTUATION, unescape\n\n\ndef run_executable(project_root: Path, data: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess[bytes]:\n    return subprocess.run(\n        [str(project_root / \"commonmark\")],\n        input=data.encode(\"utf-8\"),\n        capture_output=True,\n        cwd=project_root,\n        check=False,\n    )\n\n\n# --- Declared acceptance checks (transcribed from FEATURE-Backslash-Escapes.md) ---\n\n\ndef test_escapes_punctuation_inert(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-punctuation-inert: an escaped asterisk prevents emphasis.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\*not emphasized*\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<em>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"\\\\\") == 0\n\n\ndef test_escapes_non_punctuation_literal(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-non-punctuation-literal: a backslash before a non-punctuation character is kept.\"\"\"\n    text = \"\\\\A\\\\a\\\\3\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, text + \"\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert text in result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\ndef test_escapes_block_markers(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-block-markers: an escaped heading marker does not start a heading.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\# word\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<h1>\") == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\").count(\"<p>\") == 1\n\n\ndef test_escapes_inert_in_code_span(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"AC escapes-inert-in-code-span: a backslash in a code span is not an escape.\"\"\"\n    content = \"\\\\*\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"`\" + content + \"`\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert content in result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\")\n\n\n# --- Escaped punctuation in text ---\n\n\nHTML_TEXT_FORM = {\"&\": \"&amp;\", \"<\": \"&lt;\", \">\": \"&gt;\", '\"': \"&quot;\"}\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"char\", sorted(string.punctuation))\ndef test_escaped_punctuation_yields_the_character(char: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Every ASCII punctuation character escaped by a backslash is plain text, without the backslash.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\" + char) == HTML_TEXT_FORM.get(char, char)\n\n\ndef test_ascii_punctuation_set_matches_the_spec_list() -> None:\n    \"\"\"The escapable set is exactly the 32 ASCII punctuation characters.\"\"\"\n    assert len(ASCII_PUNCTUATION) == 32\n    assert \"\\\\\" in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n    assert \" \" not in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n    assert \"A\" not in ASCII_PUNCTUATION\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"char\", [\"*\", \"_\", \"`\", \"[\", \"]\", \"<\", there.\"\"\"\n    assert \"\\\\\" not in inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\" + char + \"x\" + char)\n\n\ndef test_escaped_backslash_leaves_next_character_unescaped() -> None:\n    \"\"\"`\\\\\\\\` yields one backslash, and the following backtick is still a live opener.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\\\\\`a`\") == \"\\\\<code>a</code>\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_backtick_does_not_open_a_code_span() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a backtick makes it literal, so it cannot open a span.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\`a`\") == \"`a`\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_ampersand_is_escaped_as_text() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escaped ampersand is shown as a literal ampersand, so an entity-like form is not decoded.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\&amp;\") == \"&amp;amp;\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_quote_renders_as_quot_entity() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escaped double quote renders as the `&quot;` entity, with no backslash.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline('\\\\\"') == \"<p>&quot;</p>\"[3:-4]\n\n\ndef test_trailing_lone_backslash_is_literal() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash at the very end of the text is kept, since nothing follows it.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"a\\\\\") == \"a\\\\\"\n\n\ndef test_backslash_before_non_punctuation_is_kept() -> None:\n    \"\"\"A backslash before a letter, digit or space stays in the text.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"\\\\a\\\\3\\\\ b\") == \"\\\\a\\\\3\\\\ b\"\n\n\ndef test_escape_inside_a_longer_text_run() -> None:\n    \"\"\"An escape in the middle of plain text consumes only its own two characters.\"\"\"\n    assert inlines.parse_inline(\"x\\\\*y*z\") == \"x*y*z\"\n\n\ndef test_escaped_text_output_is_exact(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The executable writes exactly the escaped paragraph and nothing else.\"\"\"\n    result = run_executable(project_root, \"\\\\*a\\\\* b\\n\")\n    assert result.returncode == 0\n    assert result.stdout.decode(\"utf-8\") == \"<p>*a* b</p>\\n\"\n\n\n# --- The shared unescape helper ---\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\n    (\"text\", \"expected\"),\n    [\n        (\"\", \"\"),\n {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_012ujogfT5vRRjKgMbpqBbbr","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Foundation tests: project tree, package skeleton, and the stdlib-only dependency contract.\"\"\"\n\nimport importlib\nimport os\nimport shutil\nimport subprocess\nimport sys\nimport tomllib\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nimport pytest\n\nRESERVED_MODULES = [\"blocks\", \"inlines\", \"refs\", \"entities\", \"render\", \"cli\"]\n# `cli` gained its entry point in the executable block; `blocks`, `render` and `inlines` gained\n# behavior in the block-engine build. The remaining modules stay behavior-free.\nNO_BEHAVIOR_MODULES = [\"refs\", \"entities\"]\n\n\ndef test_foundation_package_imports(project_root: Path) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Acceptance: the mdparser package and each reserved module import cleanly.\"\"\"\n    sys.path.insert(0, str(project_root))\n\n    importlib.import_module(\"mdparser\")\n    for name in RESERVED_MODULES:\n        full = \"mdparser.\" + name\n        module = importlib.import_module(full)\n        assert module.__name__ == full\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name\", RESERVED_MODULES)\ndef test_reserved_module_has_documented_responsibility(name: str) -> None:\n    module = importlib.import_module(\"mdparser.\" + name)\n    assert module.__doc__ and module.__doc__.strip()\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"name\", NO_BEHAVIOR_MODULES)\ndef test_reserved_module_has_no_behavior_yet(name: str) -> None:\n    module = importlib.import_module(\"mdparser.\" + name)\n    public = [attr for attr in vars(module) if not attr.startswith(\"_\")]\n    assert public == []\n\n\ndef test_package_is_named_mdparser_not_commonmark() -> None:\n    package = importlib.import_module(\"mdparser\")\n    assert package.__name__ == \"mdparser\"\n    with
